sources.title: AC automaton matching and immutable-version derivation

claims.text: The documented derivation supports Trie/AC use for fixed-dictionary exact multi-pattern matching, O(n+z) scan behavior after construction, and excludes semantic, image and audio review from that guarantee.

The documented immutable-version model supports request-bound snapshots, asynchronous build/validation/gray release, and rollback by selecting a previously verified version rather than mutating the online matching structure.

validation.derivation_check: 2026-07-11 reviewed AC failure-link and immutable-version invariants; all capacity/SLO values remain deployment inputs.
